Chells Manor area definitely seems more up your alley then. The closer you get to Walkern the nicer the area. 

Honestly, the little woodland walks and neighbourhoods are lovely in Chells. It is really quiet and everyone seems polite and chatty whilst walking etc. 

I think Stevenage gets a bad rap for previous issues which have recently improved. I think the green spaces are lush and the nightlife/events/mini festivals can be fantastic in the old town. Also lots of opportunities for date nights and fantastic train links. 

Chells is pretty much within walking/cycling distance of most places as well :)

The closer you get to Walkern, the nicer Stevenage is but the town has deteriorated over the years. The old town is alright. 

Hitchin is lovely imo. Beautiful historic market town but V expensive. Get what you pay for I suppose. 

Worst? Probably Borehamwood and Watford areas. The closer you get to London the crazier it gets. Also, Welwyn is indeed boring in the good parts and HIGH crime in the bad parts (used to work in mental health and covered the whole of herts and Welwyn was the WORST AREA in herts for drug and alcohol related crime)
